answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through Proof of Burn, requiring nodes to destroy scarce tokens to activate an identity. The network verifies each burn as an unspendable relic, establishing a basalt floor of sunk capital. Because burned funds cannot be recycled across instances, an attacker incurs direct financial loss per identity, opening an economic canyon against automated swarms. However, this mechanism penalizes capital-constrained agents with high entry costs.
